instruction_module.description: Critical file location rules for ALL reflow workflows - prevents most common workflow errors
instruction_module.usage: Load when agent shows confusion about where files are located

PRIMARY_RULE: ALL tracking and context files are ALWAYS located in <system_path>/context/ directory
NEVER_LOCATIONS: NEVER in specs/, services/, or docs/ directories

embedded_reflow_structure.description: When reflow is injected into a system, it creates this structure in context/

WORKING_DIRECTORY_REQUIREMENT.rule: LLM agent MUST cd to <system_path>/ at the start of EVERY workflow step
WORKING_DIRECTORY_REQUIREMENT.verification: Run 'pwd' - output must be the absolute path to your system directory
WORKING_DIRECTORY_REQUIREMENT.relative_paths: Once in correct directory, use relative paths: context/current_focus.md, context/dev_progress_tracker.json
WORKING_DIRECTORY_REQUIREMENT.common_error: If you cannot find tracking files, you are in the WRONG DIRECTORY - immediately run pwd and cd to correct location

QUICK_DIAGNOSIS.symptom: Cannot find decision_flow.json, dev_progress_tracker.json, dev_current_focus.md, or tracking files
QUICK_DIAGNOSIS.diagnosis: You are in the WRONG DIRECTORY
solution: 2. Identify correct system path from user's request or workflow context
4. Verify with 'pwd' - should show your system's absolute path
5. Run 'ls context/' - should see all tracking files listed in ALWAYS_LOCATIONS
6. Now you can access files with relative paths: context/dev_progress_tracker.json

INJECTION_SPECIFIC_LOCATIONS.description: File locations specific to inject_flow.json workflow
target_system_locations: <target_system>/context/tracking/ - WHERE original context files are moved
backup_locations: <target_system>/context_backup_<timestamp> - WHERE context backup is stored during injection

SYSTEM_STRUCTURE_REQUIREMENTS.description: Required directory structure for both source and target systems
embedded_reflow_system: ├── context/          # Now contains COMPLETE reflow environment

PATH_RESOLUTION_RULES.description: How to resolve paths correctly in different contexts
PATH_RESOLUTION_RULES.absolute_paths: Always use when invoking tools: python3 /path/to/reflow/tools/tool.py /path/to/system

CROSS_CONTAMINATION_PREVENTION.description: Critical rules to prevent mixing files between systems
mandatory_rules: NEVER reference files from other system directories
NEVER copy tracking files between systems
NEVER place reflow tools in system directories (except during injection to context/)
NEVER place system artifacts in reflow root directory
Always verify system_name in working_memory.json matches current system
isolation_verification: Before ANY file operation, verify pwd shows correct system path
Check system_name in context/working_memory.json matches target system
Ensure all file paths are relative to current system or absolute with verification

ERROR_RECOVERY.description: Recovery procedures for file location errors
wrong_directory_recovery: Document error in current directory's context/process_log.md with timestamp
Identify correct system name from user's request or workflow context
Verify: pwd must show correct system's absolute path
READ context/current_focus.md to understand current task
RESUME work with verified context and document recovery
missing_files_recovery: If expected tracking files not found in context/, verify directory first
If in wrong directory, execute wrong_directory_recovery procedure
If in correct directory but files missing, check context/tracking/ (for embedded systems)
If files genuinely missing, may need to reinitialize from templates

REINFORCEMENT: After completing ANY large task or step, immediately RE-READ this section to reestablish file location awareness
